static_proof: For LEVEL_A_WORKER, LEVEL_B_SURFACE, and CROSS_TARGET_VERIFIER and both SO and SPINDLE, the input is exactly the stored post-warmup arrays r_E_stored[n],r_T_stored[n], n=0,...,35999, sampled every fifth internal step, before centering and filtering.
x_raw[n]=float64((r_E_stored[n]+float64(0.25*r_T_stored[n]))/10.0) is evaluated as multiplication, addition, division in that order.

Both paired arrays must already be C-contiguous, one-dimensional numpy dtype <f8, shape (36000,), little-endian; no conversion is allowed. Their exact 288000-byte buffers are hashed with uppercase SHA-256 before moments.

Validation order is exact: expected intervention identity; alias and physical sham resolution; draw/seed/initial-state/duration/solver/OU/all-zero-sham checks; dtype/rank/shape/length/endianness/contiguity; raw hashes; sham-then-intervention ascending finite scan; moments only after all pass.

Means and population variances use sequential IEEE-754 binary64 accumulation in ascending index order, round-to-nearest ties-to-even, ddof=0, and no FMA, reassociation, extended precision, parallel or compensated reduction.

For positive finite variances, ratio=float64(v_sham/v_intervention), a=float64(sqrt(ratio)), then for each n d=float64(x_intervention[n]-mu_intervention), z=float64(a*d), x_rescaled[n]=float64(mu_sham+z), in that order.
No epsilon, floor, alternate normalization, post-correction, forced moment equality, clipping, detrending, interpolation, standardization, truncation, or filtered substitute exists.

Exact finite zero variance in either role is NOT_ESTIMABLE_ZERO_VARIANCE. Negative or nonfinite arithmetic is INVALID_NUMERIC. A nonfinite raw input is INVALID_NONFINITE_INPUT with the first failing role/index. A schema mismatch is INVALID_INPUT_SCHEMA. Pairing disagreement is INVALID_PAIRING. A uniquely prescribed absent or unreadable input is NOT_ESTIMABLE_INPUT.
All 36000 rescaled samples must be finite; their exact <f8 bytes are hashed, and audit-only sequential mu_rescaled/v_rescaled are logged without a tolerance-based correction or branch.

verdict_logic.PASS_STATIC_CODE_AUDIT: All activation inputs match and every inherited and V5-specific check is statically proved with no forbidden access and no unrelated drift.
verdict_logic.FAIL_BLOCKING: At least one mandatory check has a concrete contradiction, forbidden behavior, mismatch, omission, extra behavior, or drift.
verdict_logic.NOT_AUTHORIZED_INPUT_INTEGRITY: A prerequisite authorization, path, hash, size, allowlist, release, revalidation, or independent protocol audit is absent or mismatched.
verdict_logic.BLOCKED_INSUFFICIENT_STATIC_PROOF: Required behavior cannot be proved from authorized static bytes without execution or an unauthorized baseline.
verdict_logic.noncompensation: Checks are conjunctive. A fixture pass, code quality, plausible output, local validation, or another passing check cannot offset one failure or missing proof.

required_future_audit_receipt.receipt_rule: A receipt is valid only when it binds exact closed bytes and reports every check independently. It cannot self-authorize preflight, execution, or science.
